title: Staff Onboarding
summary: The six onboarding phases every new employee goes through, probation management and what managers must sign off.
body:
## 1. PURPOSE

This SOP makes sure that every new employee in every Pelagos department is onboarded in the same structured way. It sets one standard for compliance, training and service expectations, to protect the brand, operational efficiency and the guest experience. It must be followed for every new employee.

## 2. RESPONSIBILITY AND SCOPE

- **Primary responsibility:** Department Manager or Supervisor.
- **Support:** General Manager and Administration.
- **Applies to:** FOH service staff (waitrons, runners, bartenders, deli assistants), housekeeping, kitchen staff and maintenance.

## 3. FRONT OF HOUSE RECRUITS: TRAINING SHIFTS AND WRITTEN TEST

New front of house recruits (waitrons, runners, bartenders and deli assistants) complete five training shifts and pass a written test before they are appointed. **Recruits who do not pass will not be appointed.**

### 3.1 Before the first training shift

- The recruit signs a paid 6-day training contract. The five training shifts and the test day are paid at no less than the national minimum wage.
- Collect a copy of the recruit’s ID or passport (and work permit, if applicable) and their banking details, so that they can be paid for the training days.
- Ask the recruit to sign the Fingerprint Clocking Consent Form (PEL-FRM-002) and register their fingerprint, or record their times in the Manual Clocking Register (Staff Handbook, section 4.4).
- Give the recruit the New Staff Induction Guide (PEL-MAN-005) and the FOH Training Manual (PEL-MAN-004), and start a Training Completion and Sign-Off Record (PEL-FRM-005).

### 3.2 The training shifts

| **Shift**          | **Where** | **What the recruit learns**                                                                                                                                                         |
|--------------------|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Shifts 1 and 2** | Floor     | Steps of Service (PEL-SOP-001) and FOH Training Manual modules 1 to 4; table numbers; Pilot ordering and cashless payments (PEL-MAN-001, sections 5 and 6); Dineplan (PEL-SOP-003). |
| **Shift 3**        | Bar       | The drinks menu, cocktails, beer on tap and wine by the glass; wine service (PEL-MAN-003); responsible service of alcohol.                                                          |
| **Shifts 4 and 5** | Kitchen   | The food menu: dishes, ingredients and allergens; how orders reach the pass; kitchen hygiene (PEL-SOP-007).                                                                         |
| **Day 6**          | Test      | The written test, then feedback from the manager.                                                                                                                                   |

The manager may arrange the five training shifts in any order to suit the roster. The trainer records each shift on PEL-FRM-005.

### 3.3 The written test (day 6)

- There are five test papers (PEL-TST-001, Papers A to E). The manager chooses the paper and rotates them, so that recruits who train together never get the same paper.
- The test is written under supervision, closed book, in 45 minutes.
- The manager marks it with the answer sheet (PEL-TST-002). The answer sheet is kept locked away and is never given to staff.
- The pass mark is **80% (32 out of 40)**. Record the paper, score and result on PEL-FRM-005 and file the marked paper with it.

### 3.4 The result

- **Pass:** the recruit is appointed. Issue the employment contract and complete the onboarding phases in section 4.
- **Not passed:** the recruit is not appointed. The training contract ends after day 6, and the recruit is paid for every training day worked. Tell the recruit the result in person.

## 4. ONBOARDING PHASES

### Phase 1: Pre-employment compliance

Managers must make sure all documents are completed and filed before or on the employee’s first day (for front of house recruits, when they are appointed after passing the test in section 3). Record them on the New Staff Onboarding Checklist (PEL-FRM-003):

|                                        |                                       |
|----------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
| ID document or passport                | Signed offer and job description      |
| Work permit (if applicable)            | Signed employment contract            |
| Staff information sheet                | EEA1 form (Employment Equity)         |
| Bank confirmation letter and affidavit | Signed Staff Handbook acknowledgement |

### Phase 2: Day 1 induction

Every new employee must complete a structured induction:

- Full tour of the premises.
- Issue the Staff Handbook (PEL-POL-001) and the New Staff Induction Guide (PEL-MAN-005), and have the employee sign the guide’s acknowledgement.
- Explain the company culture and expectations.
- Issue the uniform and name tag.
- Have the employee sign the Fingerprint Clocking Consent form (PEL-FRM-002), then register their fingerprint on Pilot for clocking (see the Staff Handbook, section 4.4).
- Explain:
  - clocking in and out, and attendance rules;
  - the pay cycle (Staff Handbook, section 5.1) and the hourly pay calendar (PEL-MEM-015);
  - the Villa Del Mare Estate rules; and
  - the SOPs that apply to the role.

> **Key expectation:** Every new staff member must understand the Pelagos culture: warm, polished, professional hospitality.

### Phase 3: Core training (all departments)

Managers must make sure the following foundation training is completed:

- Conduct and communication standards.
- Uniform, grooming and hygiene.
- Basic food safety.
- Guest service principles.
- Emergency procedures.

> **Key standard:** Staff represent the brand at all times and must maintain professional conduct and communication.

### Phase 4: Department-specific training

| **Department**                                                         | **Training required**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | **Key expectations**                                                                              |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **FOH service staff (waitrons, runners, bartenders, deli assistants)** | Five training shifts and the written test (section 3); PEL-MAN-004 FOH Training Manual (modules 1 to 4); full steps of service; POS and order-taking accuracy; menu and product knowledge; wine service basics (where applicable); upselling; complaint handling; opening and closing duties; Dineplan; Maxiclub. | Service drives the guest experience. Staff must stay visible and attentive on the floor.          |
| **Housekeeping**                                                       | Cleaning schedules and standards; hygiene and sanitation; waste management; guest area presentation; reporting maintenance or safety issues.                                                                                                                                                                      | Cleanliness directly affects how guests see us and their safety. Attention to detail is critical. |
| **Kitchen**                                                            | Food safety and hygiene; storage, labelling and FIFO; station set-up and breakdown; preventing cross-contamination; temperature control.                                                                                                                                                                          | Food safety is non-negotiable. Clean as you go at all times.                                      |
| **Maintenance**                                                        | Equipment handling and care; preventative maintenance routines; safety procedures; incident reporting; estate rules.                                                                                                                                                                                              | Keep facilities ready to use. Report risks or faults immediately.                                 |

### Phase 5: Practical training

Managers must make sure that:

- duty lists are explained;
- opening and closing duties are trained;
- a shadow shift is completed; and
- the new employee is supervised during their first shifts.

**Progression:** 1. Observation, 2. Assisted work, 3. Supervised shift, 4. Approved for independent shifts. Each step must be signed off on the New Staff Onboarding Checklist (PEL-FRM-003).

### Phase 6: Assessment and sign-off

Before a new employee works on their own, the manager must confirm:

- they understand the SOPs for their role;
- they are operationally competent; and
- their behaviour and attitude meet our standards.

**Final steps:** for front of house staff, the trainer and manager complete the Training Completion and Sign-Off Record (PEL-FRM-005); for other departments, the manager signs Section E of the New Staff Onboarding Checklist (PEL-FRM-003). The employee signs the SOP and Memo Acknowledgement Record (PEL-FRM-001), and all documents are filed.

## 5. PROBATION MANAGEMENT

The standard probation period is 3 months, unless the employment contract says otherwise (see PEL-POL-002 Disciplinary Code and Probation Policy, section 12).

- Monitor:
  - attendance;
  - performance;
  - attitude; and
  - trainability.
- Give feedback regularly.
- Address issues early.
- Document performance concerns.

## 6. NON-NEGOTIABLE STANDARDS

All managers must enforce:

- professional conduct at all times;
- no alcohol or drugs on duty;
- accurate POS and stock handling;
- strict hygiene compliance; and
- respectful communication.

> **Critical rule:** Staff must never compromise the guest experience, safety or the company’s reputation.

## 7. MANAGER ACCOUNTABILITY

Managers are responsible for:

- completing the New Staff Onboarding Checklist (PEL-FRM-003) in full;
- recording every group training session on the Training Session Record (PEL-FRM-004);
- making sure training is consistent and of good quality;
- signing off only staff who are competent; and
- keeping the documentation records.

Failure to onboard staff properly may lead to service failures, compliance risks and disciplinary action.

## 8. QUICK MANAGER CHECKLIST

Before approving a new staff member for independent shifts:

| **Item**                                                                        | **Done ✓** |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| Front of house: five training shifts done and written test passed (PEL-FRM-005) |            |
| Documents complete and filed (Phase 1)                                          |            |
| Day 1 induction done, consent form signed, fingerprint registered               |            |
| SOPs explained                                                                  |            |
| Core and department training complete                                           |            |
| Shadow shift done                                                               |            |
| Independent shift approved                                                      |            |
| Acknowledgement record (PEL-FRM-001) signed                                     |            |

## 9. RELATED DOCUMENTS

- PEL-FRM-003 New Staff Onboarding Checklist
- PEL-FRM-004 Training Session Record
- PEL-FRM-005 Training Completion and Sign-Off Record
- PEL-TST-001 FOH Training Test (Papers A to E) and PEL-TST-002 Answer Sheet
- PEL-MAN-004 FOH Training Manual
- PEL-MAN-005 New Staff Induction Guide
- PEL-FRM-001 SOP and Memo Acknowledgement Record
- PEL-FRM-002 Fingerprint Clocking Consent Form
- PEL-POL-001 Staff Handbook
- PEL-POL-002 Disciplinary Code and Probation Policy
- PEL-MEM-015 Hourly Pay Calendar 2026 to 2027
